/privacy.body:
PRIVACY NOTICE

Your details.
Handled with care.

Preview notice · Updated 29 October 2026

BEFORE YOU SUBMIT

A preview.
Use test details only.

This preview is operated by Kamil (mkamil5656@gmail.com) to demonstrate a proposed website to MMA Garden Services. It is not the business’s operational booking system.

What is stored

The request form stores the name, email, telephone, postcode, address, chosen service, preferred visit window, notes and any photos you submit. A short-lived hashed network identifier is used to limit spam. Use fictional details and photos without identifiable people, house numbers or other private information.

Why it is stored and who can see it

Test requests demonstrate the workflow. Only authorised administrators and staff can view requests and photographs. Photos are stored privately and are not displayed in the public gallery. We do not use request details for marketing.

Hosting and retention

The application uses the Vercel hosting with Supabase database, authentication and private photo storage. Hosting providers process data to operate the service. Contact Kamil to request access or deletion of a test submission; avoid sending identity documents. Demo data should be cleared at the end of the evaluation and before client handover.

Cookies and sign-in

No advertising or analytics cookies are installed by this application. Platform authentication cookies may be used when an owner signs in. Admin access uses Supabase email authentication plus a server-side access list.

Before a real business launch

The business must approve the live privacy notice, controller details, lawful basis, retention schedule, access list, processor arrangements and contact routes before accepting real customer data. This notice does not assert that MMA Garden Services has approved those arrangements.

THE WEBSITE PROPOSAL

A new chapter.
Built around your business.

A considered digital home, from the first impression to the next garden visit.

PREPARED FOR MMA GARDEN SERVICES · 29 OCTOBER 2026

One place to be found.
One place to manage the work.

A proposed website and booking workspace by Kamil. The aim is to make services easier to understand and give the team useful information before travelling to a garden. These are proposed benefits, not guaranteed sales results.

01 / ONE-TIME BUILD

£1,950

Fixed project fee · no compulsory retainer

  • Responsive marketing website and dedicated service pages
  • Individual social sharing images and page metadata
  • Date/time visit requests and private garden photo uploads
  • Owner/admin workspace, team access and booking review
  • Editable service copy and price labels, draft/publish and revision history
  • Availability controls and staff assignment
  • Two revision rounds, training and handover
  • 30 days of fixes for agreed-scope defects after launch

50% (£975) on project acceptance; 50% (£975) after acceptance checks and before production handover. Target delivery: 10–15 working days after scope, content and access are approved, subject to scheduling.

02 / OPTIONAL ONGOING CARE

£95/ month

Optional support alongside the one-time build

  • Dependency and security maintenance
  • Monthly booking-flow and site health checks
  • Backup verification and restore assistance
  • Up to 60 minutes of small content/configuration changes per month
  • Email support during agreed business hours

Month to month, with 30 days’ notice. Unused change time does not roll over. New features, paid integrations and substantial redesigns are quoted separately.

WHAT’S SEPARATE

A clear scope.
A fair handover.

Hosting, domain registration, email delivery and third-party subscriptions are paid separately to the provider or itemised by agreement. Any applicable VAT treatment will be confirmed before invoicing. No paid plan is purchased through this preview.

Online payments, SMS, route optimisation, automatic recurring appointments, complex multi-team scheduling and a full rebrand are outside this scope. The booking flow records visit requests; appointments require owner review. Outbound booking email is not configured in this preview.

The source code and business content are handed over after final payment, subject to third-party and open-source licences. The business owns its domain and approved customer data. Client photos replace generated visual studies before any portfolio claims are made.

BEFORE LAUNCH

Make it
yours.

  1. Approve identity, service areas, prices, VAT and cancellation terms.
  2. Supply licensed project photography, logos and final copy.
  3. Confirm staff accounts and availability rules.
  4. Approve privacy and data retention arrangements.
  5. Test a booking with photos, review it in the CMS, and test content publishing.
  6. Approve the live domain, hosting costs and notification delivery before real bookings are enabled.

This is a proposal, not an accepted contract. We agree the final scope, delivery dates and terms before starting paid work.
